prompt:
FNA
• It is easily performed, is rapid, inexpensive, and no incision is required. It requires a trained cytopathologist to report.
Cannot distinguish between in situ and invasive cancer.
Markers (ER, PR, Her-2-neu) are not routinely available.
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 most directly addresses the prompt’s specific points about FNA (rapid/minimally invasive with cytopathologist reporting, inability to distinguish in situ vs invasive cancer, and limited routine availability of ER/PR/Her-2-neu markers). Candidate 2 covers general FNA limitations but omits the prompt’s key in situ vs invasive and marker-availability points. Candidate 3 focuses mainly on the cytopathologist role and misses the cancer-typing and marker limitations, while Candidate 4 drifts into broad comparisons with other modalities/procedures without clearly addressing those two key limitations.
